name: EZ Cubes Spring 2017

venue.name: University of Mary Washington, University Center, Chandler Ballroom

information: The registration fee is $20. There is a 100 person competitor limit with no at-the-door registration.  Also t-shirts are available for $20 (see Shirts).  To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact me to resolve the issue. The event list consists of: Rubik's Cube, 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, Clock, and a Mystery Event for 3x3 finalists.
